purpose: A drop area that accepts dragged files and opens the file picker from its Choose file button. Use it at the top of a FileUpload, or alone where files are the whole task.

notFor.case: People need to follow the progress of several files.
A dense form row with no room for a drop area (FileUpload's trigger layout).
Showing a picture that is already uploaded.

Default.visual: Surface/layer-1 fill, Border/control edge; icon and description Content/secondary, title Content/primary.

Hover.visual: Edge moves to Border/control-hover; everything else as Default.

Dragging.meaning: Files are dragged over the area.
Dragging.visual: Surface/accent fill, Border/accent edge; icon, title and description Content/accent.

Invalid.meaning: The drop or pick was rejected; the title becomes the message.
Invalid.visual: Status/critical/surface fill, Status/critical/border-strong edge; icon, title and description Status/critical/content.

Disabled.visual: Action/disabled/default fill, Border/control edge; icon, title and description Content/disabled; the Button is disabled.

a11y.role: none on the drop area (it takes no focus); the Choose file trigger is a Button
a11y.keyboard: Tab reaches the Button; Enter or Space opens the native picker. Dropping is pointer only; the Button is the keyboard path.
notes: aria-disabled when disabled; aria-invalid with a visible message when invalid.
The OR separator stays Content/secondary in every state, Disabled included.
Fill and edge move on use-hover (recipes/motion.ts).

openQuestions: Reduced motion: should the fill and edge transitions (use-hover) into Dragging be dropped?
Invalid replaces the title with the message. Is that change announced (live region), or only shown?
